abstract: Both the sensitivity to MTX and hCG secretion were compared in two choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo and HCCM-5) and study on mechanisms about MTX-resistance was described. The uptake of nucleotides and protein precursors was decreased in dose-dependent manner in both cell lines when exposed to MTX, but HCCM-5 cells showed more sensitivity to MTX. In HCCM-5 cells, both hCG and hCG-beta levels in the medium were decreased with exposure to 10(-9)M MTX, but they tended to increase when exposed to higher concentration of MTX in contrast to the inhibition of 3H-thymidine uptake. However, in BeWo cells, an inverse relationship between the incorporation of 3H-thymidine and secretion of hCG was not clearly observed. The content of dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) in HCCM-5 cells was about one-half of that in BeWo cells. Although the peak of 3H-MTX incorporation was observed at 120 minutes in both cell lines, HCCM-5 cells incorporated about 4 times higher 3H-MTX than BeWo cells. The difference of sensitivity to MTX between those two cell lines seems to be concerned with both the decrease of MTX transport and increase of intracellular DHFR levels.
abstract_ja: 2種の絨毛癌細胞株BeWoとHCCM-5において、メトトレキサート(MTX)感受性とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌を比較した。両細胞株でMTXへの暴露により、ヌクレオチドおよびタンパク前駆体の取り込みが用量依存的に減少したが、HCCM-5細胞はMTXに対してより感受性が高かった。HCCM-5細胞では、10^-9MのMTX暴露により培地中のhCG、hCG-βの両レベルが低下したが、3H-チミジン取り込みの阻害とは対照的に、より高濃度のMTXに暴露されると増加する傾向があった。一方、BeWo細胞では、3H-チミジンの取り込みとhCG分泌の逆相関は明確には認められなかった。HCCM-5細胞のジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素（DHFR）含量はBeWo細胞の約半分であった。両細胞株で3H-MTXの取り込みピークは120分に観察されたが、HCCM-5細胞はBeWo細胞の約4倍の3H-MTXを取り込んだ。両細胞株間のMTX感受性の差は、MTX輸送の低下と細胞内DHFRレベルの上昇の両方に関連していると考えられる。
